data.name: Sukhlal
data.gender_notes: Sukhlal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sukh meaning happiness, lal meaning red or passion. Sukhlal is a name which signifies a person who is full of joy and happiness. The name Sukhlal carries the meaning “Happiness, Joy, Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sukhlal usually hope their child will grow to embody happiness, joy, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Sukhlal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Happiness, Joy, Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sukhlal total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
